hero.title: Turn your trip plan<0/>into a single <1>booklet</1>.
hero.lead: Edit routes, day-by-day itinerary, places to visit, budget and notes in one place, then export straight to PDF. Shape your trip by chatting with AI.
hero.previewAlt: The shiori app: browse your candidate spots while chatting with AI to move your trip planning forward.

workflow.title: Discover, plan, and make it a booklet
workflow.lead: The AI agent researches history, food, culture and nature from web searches and document scans. Turn the spots you find into an efficient itinerary, import receipts and invoices to keep track of costs, and finish with a PDF or HTML booklet.

flow.aria: Inside the shiori workspace, four phases progress: discovery, planning, bookings and cost management, and booklet creation. Web search and OCR of documents, receipts and invoices come in as external inputs; PDF and HTML go out as external outputs.

step2.title: Planning
step2.desc1: See the whole trip on a map

agent.title: AI agent
agent.desc: Autonomously uses web search and document reading to research and propose destinations and routes. It doesn't just chat, it moves your trip forward.

spots.title: Candidate spots
spots.desc: Stock up places you want to visit and manage them with notes. Drop the ones you like straight into your itinerary.

map.title: Map & routes
map.desc: Line up waypoints and transport modes to visualize each leg as a route on the map, distinguishing rail, flights and walking.

itinerary.title: Day-by-day itinerary
itinerary.desc: Stack up plans for each day and reorder by drag and drop. A timeline that shows travel and stays at a glance.

budget.title: Budget
budget.desc: Record estimates and actual costs per category. Plan while keeping the big picture and your wallet in balance.

export.title: PDF & HTML export
export.desc: Print or export the finished booklet to PDF. A single document you can check offline, wherever you are.

memo.title: Notes
memo.desc: Packing lists, booking numbers, on-site discoveries: keep every travel note in one place and jot things down the moment they come to mind.

s1.title: Log in to get started
s1.desc: Sign in with your Google account in seconds and start building your first trip right away.

s2.title: Build your trip
s2.desc: Collect spots you want to visit, line up routes and a day-by-day itinerary, then add budget and notes.

s3.title: Take the booklet with you
s3.desc: Share it with companions or export it to PDF. On the day, it becomes your travel companion.

cta.title: Start planning your next trip today
cta.lead: Sign in with your Google account and create your itinerary.
